about: Deep Made Simple — stories. Supplementary, not Scripture. A story introduces passages and links them in order; it never retells them. Each step names a verse and an exact phrase from the KJV (checked by scripts/pipeline/deep.py and tests/unit/deep.test.ts); the app shows the whole verse from the reader's active translation. Each link says why one step follows the last: later in the same chapter, a word that stands in both verses, or an existing connection with its evidence level. Notes are short signposts, not Scripture. Authored as AI drafts; a named human reviewer must review every story before it is published.

stories.title: From Abram to Bethlehem
stories.summary: A walk through passages from Genesis 12, the book of Ruth and Matthew 1–2, each linked to the one before it by the wording of the text.

steps.phrase: Get thee out of thy country
steps.note: Genesis 12 begins with these words to Abram.

steps.phrase: there was a famine in the land
there was a famine in the land
steps.note: The book of Ruth opens with the same words.

steps.phrase: the name of the other Ruth
So Boaz took Ruth
he is the father of Jesse, the father of David
Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse
Jesse begat David the king
of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ
Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea
And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda
But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah

stories.title: Matthew 1–2: “by the prophet”
stories.summary: The places in Matthew 1–2 where the text says a word was spoken or written by a prophet, each followed by the passage it is linked to.

steps.phrase: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet
Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son
thus it is written by the prophet
out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet
called my son out of Egypt
Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet
A voice was heard in Ramah
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets
steps.note: Here the text says “the prophets” and names no passage; this edition does not assign one.

stories.title: From the beginning to Haran
stories.summary: A line through Genesis 1–12, following the words the chapters share: created, generations, and the names in the lists.

steps.phrase: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
